description: Same physical network as case01, but the collection point is a plain perimeter NGFW, not host-routed. Only traffic that actually crosses the DMZ is visible. Area-to-area traffic may or may not be restricted underneath, but this deployment shape has no evidence either way. The correct engine output for Clause 2 here is an explicit no-evidence / insufficient-evidence verdict, not a pass and not a planted-violation fail -- see README for why this case exists beyond the three violation types named in the current paper draft's Section 5.1 text.
notes: No VLAN12/13/14/15 records exist in this evidence set at all, by construction -- that traffic never transits the perimeter appliance under this deployment shape, so the engine has nothing to check Clause 2 against.
